🌈 EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATOR (ECE) – FULL TIME 🌈
Little Acorns Learning Village – Langford, BC

👋 WHO WE ARE
Little Acorns Learning Village is a fictional, play-based childcare centre with 3 rooms for toddlers and preschoolers. We believe every child deserves to feel safe, seen and celebrated!

📋 WHAT YOU'LL DO
✅ Plan and lead play-based activities that follow the BC Early Learning Framework
✅ Observe and document children's learning and share updates with families
✅ Support children through routines: meals, naps, toileting and transitions
✅ Keep the room safe, clean and welcoming
✅ Work as a team with 2 other educators in the toddler room

⭐ WHAT YOU NEED
👉 ECE Certificate (or ECE Assistant certificate and working toward full ECE)
👉 Valid Standard First Aid and CPR Level C (child and infant)
👉 Clear criminal record check (vulnerable sector)
👉 Patience, warmth and a good sense of humour!!

💛 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
✨ $26–$30/hr plus the $4/hr ECE wage enhancement
✨ Paid professional development days
✨ Extended health & dental after 3 months
✨ 50% childcare discount

🎉 PERKS
🍎 Free healthy snacks & coffee
🧘 Wellness days

🚀 WHY JOIN US
Small ratios, supportive director, and a team that actually likes each other 😊

📩 Send your resume to the director. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
